pr_body:
IsIPv6UniqueLocal boolean property was added to IPAddress. 
In September 2004 was deprecated the definition of the IPv6 site local range. As a result, in October 2005 for use in private IPv6 networks was defined the associated term **unique local addresses**.

Fix [#45148](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/45148)

issue_context.title: Add IsIPv6UniqueLocal to IPAddress
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/ncl See info in area-owners.md if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
## Background and Motivation The `IPAddress` class contains a property `IsIPv6SiteLocal`, but the IPv6 site local range has been deprecated since 2004. Since October 2005, a new range has been reserved by IETF to denote "Unique Local Addresses" (ULA) for use within private networks. It would be nice if `IPAddress` also had a property that checks for this range. ## Proposed API ```csharp public bool IsIPv6UniqueLocalAddress { get { return IsIPv6 && ((_numbers[0] & 0xFE00) == 0xFC00); } } ```
Author: huysentruitw
Assignees: -
Labels: `api-suggestion`, `area-System.Net`, `untriaged`
Milestone: -
This seems like a good thing to do.

Triage: Sounds reasonable. Not a high priority, but we will take a PR once the API is formally approved in API review.
@huysentruitw are there other IPv6 properties we might consider exposing with this one?

@karelz I'm not sure what the question is.

Regarding IPv6, we already have these properties:

| Property | Description
| --------- | ---
| IsIPv6LinkLocal | Gets whether the address is an IPv6 link local address.
| IsIPv6Multicast | Gets whether the address is an IPv6 multicast global address.
| IsIPv6SiteLocal | Gets whether the address is an IPv6 site local address.
| IsIPv6Teredo | Gets whether the address is an IPv6 Teredo address.

I think adding `IsIPv6UniqueLocal` would make that list complete for now.

I can make a PR for that once the API is approved.
Note the approved name for this property is `IsIPv6UniqueLocal`, without "Address" on the end as originally proposed.

review_comments: Thanks for the PR.  To be complete, this also needs to include the new member in the System.Net.Primitives/ref/System.Net.Primitives.cs reference assembly file, and tests.
